facts.text: The building dates back to the 1600s, when it hosted the Convento di San Francesco monastery.
facts.excerpt: dates back to the 1600s

facts.text: The hotel is a Dimora Storica, an ancient building recognized as part of Italy's historic and cultural heritage.
facts.excerpt: an ancient building that has been recognized as part of Italy’s historic and cultural heritage

facts.text: Towards the mid-1800s the monastery became the Hospital of the Marine Military, and later the headquarters of the Municipality of Porto Venere.
facts.excerpt: Towards the mid-1800s, the monastery was transformed into the Hospital of the Marine Military, and later still into the headquarters of the Municipality of Porto Venere.

facts.text: The restoration brought back details of the original convent, including red-brick vaulted ceilings.
facts.excerpt: brought back to life beautiful details of the original convent, including red-brick vaulted ceilings

facts.text: The historic complex became a hotel in 1975, closed in the 2000s and reopened in 2014 under new management after refurbishment.
facts.excerpt: In 1975, the historic complex was transformed into a hotel that eventually closed in the 2000s. In 2014 it reopened under new management and impressive refurbishment

facts.text: The hotel overlooks the marina and the historic center of Porto Venere.
facts.excerpt: overlooks the **marina** and the **historic center** of Porto Venere

facts.text: The hotel is steps away from the boats to the Cinque Terre and the Bay of La Spezia.
facts.excerpt: It is just steps away from the boats that take you to the Cinque Terre and the Bay of La Spezia

facts.text: The hotel sits between the Cinque Terre and the Gulf of Poets in eastern Liguria.
facts.excerpt: between the famous Cinque Terre and the inspirational Gulf of Poets in eastern Liguria

facts.text: A large terrace overlooks the village and harbor of Portovenere.
facts.excerpt: the grand terrace overlooking the charming village and harbor of Portovenere

facts.text: Many rooms have terraces, balconies and French windows overlooking the bay and the village.
facts.excerpt: Many rooms are also enriched with terraces, balconies and French windows overlooking the bay and the village

facts.text: The Cloister Junior Suites have a panoramic terrace under the arches of the ancient cloister.
facts.excerpt: With a panoramic terrace under the arches that belonged to the ancient cloister

facts.text: The Suite dei Poeti overlooks the Gulf of Poets and has a bespoke cellar for private wine tastings.
facts.excerpt: It features a bespoke cellar for private wine tastings.

facts.text: The Scriptorium Studio has a writing desk reminiscent of the historic convent's Scriptorium.
facts.excerpt: a writing desk reminiscent of the historic convent’s Scriptorium

facts.text: Deluxe Rooms have large windows overlooking Palmaria Island or the castle and hills of Portovenere.
facts.excerpt: Deluxe Rooms are bright and feature large windows overlooking Palmaria Island or the castle and hills of Portovenere.

facts.text: The Portovenere Wellness center offers a humid zone, a relaxation area with herbal teas, a fitness room, and massages and beauty treatments.
facts.excerpt: Our wellness center offers a humid zone; a relaxation area with herbal teas; a fitness room; and different massages and beauty treatments.

facts.text: Guests can rent boats, including the traditional Ligurian gozzo, to explore the coastline.
facts.excerpt: Choose from a selection of vessels, including the traditional Ligurian _gozzo_

facts.text: The hotel partners with beach clubs in Portovenere, with access at an extra charge.
facts.excerpt: Access to the beach clubs is subject to an extra charge.

facts.text: The hotel has an on-site garage, with free parking for direct bookings.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel features an on-site garage. We offer free car parking for direct bookings.

facts.text: When ferries are suspended due to bad weather or rough seas, the hotel offers a minivan transfer to and from La Spezia Station at scheduled times.
facts.excerpt: offers a transfer service when the ferries are suspended due to bad weather or rough seas. The minivan is available to/from La Spezia Station at scheduled times.

facts.text: Palmaria Restaurant sits on a veranda overlooking Portovenere.
facts.excerpt: Palmaria Restaurant sits on a **spectacular veranda** overlooking Portovenere.

facts.text: Breakfast is served in the sea-view Palmaria Restaurant and is complimentary for direct bookings.
facts.excerpt: Our breakfast is always complimentary for Direct Bookings!

facts.text: Palmaria Restaurant offers gluten-free menus as part of the Italian Celiac Association.
facts.excerpt: As part of the Italian Celiac Association (AIC), Palmaria Restaurant is attentive to the specific needs of its customers and offers **gluten-free menus**.

facts.text: Palmaria Restaurant asks guests to attend meals in formal attire.
facts.excerpt: We kindly request the Palmaria Restaurant guests to attend meals in formal attire.

facts.text: The area has 120 km of hiking trails.
facts.excerpt: Hike along 120km of wonderful trails for beginners, occasional hikers and pros.

facts.text: The Gulf of Poets inspired writers including Lord Byron, Percy Bysshe Shelley, D. H. Lawrence and George Sand.
facts.excerpt: Among them: writers David Herbert Lawrence and Percy Bysshe Shelley, writer and painter George Sand, and poet Lord Byron.

facts.text: Trumpeter Lorenzo Cimino composed a jazz tune exclusively for Grand Hotel Portovenere.
facts.excerpt: Renowned musician and trumpeter Lorenzo Cimino has composed a unique and jazzy tune exclusively for Grand Hotel Portovenere

facts.text: The hotel calls itself the only 5-star boutique hotel in the Cinque Terre - Gulf of Poets area.
facts.excerpt: the only 5-star boutique hotel in the Cinque Terre – Gulf of Poets area
